name: Camera and Attach on the side button
author: wizard
description: WizardOS Android app: while you talk to the side-button orb, Camera takes a photo and Attach picks pictures or files from the phone, next to Screen. Everything goes with the voice message, up to eight things, and each button shows its count. The recording pauses while the camera or picker is open and carries on when you come back. Never on the lock screen.
